title: code-submissions queue payload
description: BullMQ job payload for the 'code-submissions' queue. Produced by nextjs-web (POST /api/v1/submissions), consumed by executor-worker.

application_id.description: The application UUID this code submission belongs to.

language.description: Programming language (must match a coding_language enum value: python, javascript, typescript, java, cpp, c, csharp, go, rust, ruby, swift, kotlin, php, sql, r).

test_cases.description: Optional inline test cases. If omitted, the worker loads test cases from the coding_test_cases table for the assigned problem.

input.description: stdin input for this test case.

time_limit.description: Optional CPU time limit in milliseconds. Overrides the problem's default.
